result.changelog:
Fixed every error item. Aberax is now a class of large command-rank Pirates in all entries. In-game logbook ranks used: Armstrong is a Private, Tokabi a Corporal with an arrowhead-shaped talisman. The twelve Lamorn left through the Master Teleporter carrying return teleporters. The Vi-O-La gathers Green Energy Crystals, but only the Temple of Memory altar extracts their energy. Samus first rode the Vi-O-La at Volt Forge.
Checked unverified items with searches and fetches. Psy-bot Mimic is a fan name, so content says Psy-bots disguised in his likeness and the name stays only as a key. Metroid Wiki confirms the Shock Coil 'banned/high-density neutrinos' text from the Hunters logbook, so it was kept. Game8 and GameRant place the Sanctum of the Guardians in Fury Green, not the Chrono Tower, so it moved to the Grievers entry. Gravinax keeps its name, but its physical description and the claim that the Omega Griever killed it were dropped. Tanabe confirmed the healing-pod, chance-arrival, mind-link and 11-teleporter facts.
Removed or softened: Lamorn physical description and crystal-birth claims, Tanamaar's moon and terrain, breach-charge scene, Duke and 'Samus nodded' moments, Psy-bot pods, 'psychic-only' teleporter rule, Lockjaw black hole, 'carried into the tower', green-glowing growths, and the speculative hatchling line.
Added missing facts: 20X5 Metroid theft and Sylux spying on Samus, Betsy as a Heavyweight-Class Golem MK-99, Duke's missed promotion, Chatoya's Sacred Shrines, eleven remaining teleporters, the Lamorn refusing to attack Grievers, Aeronaut/Marauder, Keratos's intelligence, Omega Griever's keratinized hide, and IC-mode sensor details.
Key changes: removed Chosen One, alien artifact, UTO, Myles, Armstrong, Betsy, Base Camp, motorcycle, hover bike, Memory Tree and Metroid fusion (it collides with the game title). Added Lamorn Chosen One, Tanamaar artifact, Sanctum of the Guardians, Snow Wolf/Wolves, Varmis, Psy-bot Soldier(s), Betsy mech, MK-99 and Green Energy Crystals.
Retitled two entries: 'Tanamaar and the UTO Research Center' and '...stranded Federation squad'. Trimmed all entries to the length limits: Sylux 547 words, incident 547, others 400 or fewer.
result.unresolved: Tanabe's 'both became beings filled with murderous hostility' is ambiguous (it could mean Sylux or the fused Metroid), so it was left out. Gravinax's death by the Omega Griever is unconfirmed; content says only that Gravinax was gone. The world where Samus ended up after teleporting is still unidentified. The 20X5 (in-game logbook) and 20X6 (Nintendo Today) dates for the theft conflict; 20X5 was used. The link between the Federation Force egg and the 20X5 theft is taken from the draft and Nintendo World Report. Chrono Tower room names (Statuary Hall, Nexus of Hope) come only from ludo.guide. Tokabi's thrown object is called a tag, a pendant or a charm depending on the source. Sylux's flashback (Prime 3-era ship) clashes with a pre-Hunters origin; this is left to the timeline domain. Metroid Wiki spells Mackenzie, the game spells MacKenzie; the key matches both.
